title: Render Verification IR — per-video sidecar (<video>.mp4.json)
description: The durable verification record written next to every rendered mp4 by app/jobs.py:_write_video_sidecar. Contract: reference-architecture.md §6.8 (invariants VI-1..VI-3). violations_remaining describes the SHIPPED file, post-repair. Ephemeral run state (state/success/logs/render_duration_seconds) belongs to the job store, never here.

job_id.description: The render job that produced this artifact.

repair_rounds.description: Accepted repair rounds actually applied to the shipped file. 0 with violations_remaining > 0 means the repair agent never ran; > 0 with violations means repair ran and could not do better.

violations_remaining.description: LAYOUT_VIOLATION count measured on the shipped video (post-repair logs — VI-2).

animation_beats.description: Number of self.play beats in the shipped program(s).

scenes_repaired.description: Parallel path only: scenes whose repair candidate was accepted.

vision_findings.description: Vision-QA findings remaining on the shipped file (0 when VISION_QA is off or the frames are clean). Counted separately from violations_remaining: vision-* lines are never geometric violations.

voice_degraded.description: Count of TTS_DEGRADED markers in the render logs: cues that shipped on a FALLBACK voice (gemini-fallback / gtts-keyless / silence) because the primary provider failed. > 0 means the audio is not what the persona asked for; `silence` means the video has no narration at all.
